title: Proof of Dev
tagline: Proof of development - get rewarded for open source contributions
description:
The project idea is simple. We allow open source contributors to get rewarded for their contributions and get a proof of development NFT for their contributions. 

We are using github oauth apis to verify project ownership and contributions. 

We are using ERC-191 for message signing and ERC-721 for NFTs. Currently, theses are non upgradeable contracts.
how_its_made:
Chain: FEVM 
Storage: IPFS, Web3Storage
Backend: NodeJS, Express (Typescript), Solidity, Hardhat
Frontend: ReactJS(NextJS), Typescript, Tailwind, RadixUI, Vercel
